title: Seed data — named scenarios of realistic sample data
description: Written by architecture-datamodel (tree/10_blueprint/datamodel/seed.md). Mirrors the host's SeedData shape (shared/schemas/seed.ts). What the schema cannot check: that entity keys exist in model.json, that relation ids resolve inside their own scenario, and that populated covers every enum value.

scenarios.description: At minimum empty, single_user, populated and edge_cases; further scenarios such as permissions are allowed.

description.description: What state the scenario puts the app in.

data.description: Entity key to records. Keys are singular snake_case names matching model.json; relation fields end in _id; enum values are PascalCase.

record.description: One row; field names are snake_case.
